BU BET — KITOBNING OLD MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


MUQOVADAGI MATN:

  Beginner            — daraja
  COURSEBOOK          — kitob turi
  ENTERPRISE          — seriya nomi
  1                   — bosqich raqami
  Virginia Evans -
     Jenny Dooley     — mualliflar
  Express Publishing  — nashriyot


⚠ 'ENTERPRISE' SO'ZI NIMA DEGANI:

  'an enterprise' ikki ma'noda:

     1) TAShABBUS, jasorat, dadillik
     2) KORXONA, tadbirkorlik

  ⚠ Kitob nomida BIRINChI ma'no nazarda
  tutilgan: til o'rganish — jasorat
  talab qiladigan ish.

  ⚠ 'enterprising' (sifat) = tashabbuskor,
  uddaburon.


⚠ 'BEGINNER' — DARAJA:

  'begin' (boshlamoq) + '-er'
     = boshlovchi

  ⚠ 'begin' da 'n' IKKILANADI: beginNer
  (urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda bo'lgani uchun).

  ⚠ Enterprise seriyasi TO'RT bosqichli:
     Enterprise 1 — Beginner
     Enterprise 2 — Elementary
     Enterprise 3 — Pre-Intermediate
     Enterprise 4 — Intermediate

  ⚠ Bu ma'lumot orqa muqovada aytilgan:
  'the first in a FOUR-LEVEL series'.


⚠ MUALLIFLAR:

  Virginia Evans va Jenny Dooley —
  Express Publishing nashriyotining
  eng mashhur mualliflari.

  ⚠ Uchala kitobimiz ham (Coursebook,
  Workbook, Grammar Book) shu ikki
  muallifniki.

  ⚠ Ismlar orasida DEFIS emas, TIRE
  qo'yilgan: 'Evans - Dooley'.


MUQOVADAGI TO'RT SURAT:

  1) OQ BOShLI BURGUT (bald eagle)
     Suv ustida uchmoqda, panjalari
     cho'zilgan — baliq ovlayapti.
     ⚠ AQShning davlat ramzi.

  2) ShAMOL TEGIRMONI (windmill)
     Oq yog'och tegirmon.
     ⚠ Angliyaning Norfolk hududi va
     Gollandiya uchun xos.

  3) BALIQChILAR (fishing)
     Qamishzorda qayiqda o'tirgan shlyapali
     erkak va bola.

  4) TROPIK BALIQ
     Suv ostidagi pushti-binafsha baliq.

  ⚠ To'rt surat TABIAT va SAYOhAT
  mavzusini bildiradi — kitobning ruhiga
  mos.


⚠ NEGA MUQOVADA RASM MUHIM:

  Muqova kitobning MAVZUSINI oldindan
  aytadi. Bu — 154, 156, 160, 162-betlardagi
  'Pre-reading Activity' mashqlari bilan
  bir xil g'oya: rasmga qarab mazmunni
  taxmin qilish.


⚠ 'A COVER' — KITOB QISMLARI:

     the front cover  = old muqova
     the back cover   = orqa muqova
     the spine        = kitob tikilgan qirrasi
     the title page   = titul varag'i
     the contents     = mundarija


⚠ QORA YORLIQ:

  Logotip ustida kichik qora to'rtburchak
  bor — ehtimol soxtalikka qarshi
  GOLOGRAMMA yorlig'i.

  ⚠ Skanerda yozuvi aniq o'qilmaydi,
  shuning uchun taxmin sifatida yozildi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an enterprise = tashabbus; korxona
  enterprising  = tashabbuskor
  a beginner    = boshlovchi
  a level       = daraja, bosqich
  an author     = muallif
  a publisher   = nashriyot
  a cover       = muqova
  an eagle      = burgut
  a windmill    = shamol tegirmoni
  to fish       = baliq ovlamoq
  a reed        = qamish
  tropical      = tropik

BU BET — TITUL VARAG'I
(the title page).

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


⚠ TITUL VARAG'I NIMA UChUN KERAK:

  Muqova YIRTILIB ketishi yoki
  yo'qolishi mumkin. Titul varag'i esa
  kitob ichida — u yerda kitobning
  RASMIY ma'lumotlari saqlanadi.

  ⚠ Kutubxonalar kitobni aynan TITUL
  VARAG'I bo'yicha ro'yxatga oladi,
  muqova bo'yicha emas.


⚠ MUQOVADAN FARQI:

  Titul varag'ida:
     • RASM YO'Q
     • fon OQ
     • matn markazlashtirilgan

  ⚠ Ma'lumot esa deyarli BIR XIL:
  kitob nomi, turi, darajasi, mualliflar,
  nashriyot.

  ⚠ Rang farqi ham bor:
     muqovada 'ENTERPRISE' — OQ harflar
     titulda  'ENTERPRISE 1' — YAShIL


BETDAGI MATN:

  ENTERPRISE 1        — nom va bosqich
  COURSEBOOK          — kitob turi
  Beginner            — daraja
  Virginia Evans -
     Jenny Dooley     — mualliflar
  Express Publishing  — nashriyot


⚠ 'A TITLE' — KO'P MA'NOLI:

     'a title' = 1) sarlavha, nom
                 2) unvon (Mr, Dr, Sir)
                 3) chempionlik unvoni

  ⚠ 'the title page' = titul varag'i

  ⚠ 'entitled' = ... deb nomlangan:
     'a book entitled "Enterprise 1"'


⚠ KITOBNING KIRISh QISMI TARTIBI:

  1) old muqova (front cover)
  2) TITUL VARAG'I (title page)  ← bu bet
  3) mualliflik huquqi (copyright page)
  4) mundarija (contents)
  5) birinchi bet

  ⚠ Bu tartib deyarli barcha kitoblarda
  bir xil.

  ⚠ Workbook va Grammar Book'da ham shu
  tartib bor edi.


⚠ HARFLAR ORASIDAGI KENG ORALIQ:

  'C O U R S E B O O K'

  ⚠ Bu — dizayn usuli, 'letter spacing'
  yoki 'tracking' deyiladi.

  ⚠ Kitob nomini ko'zga tashlanadigan
  qilish uchun ishlatiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a title       = sarlavha, nom; unvon
  the title page = titul varag'i
  entitled      = ... deb nomlangan
  a copyright page = mualliflik huquqi beti
  contents      = mundarija
  a library     = kutubxona
  to catalogue  = ro'yxatga olmoq
  centred       = markazlashtirilgan
  spacing       = oraliq

BU BET — MUNDARIJANING ChAP BETI.

  Mundarija IKKI BETLIK YOYMA:
     2-bet — GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY,
             READING
     3-bet — LISTENING & SPEAKING,
             COMMUNICATION, WRITING


TO'LIQ MUNDARIJA (2-bet):

─── MODULE 1 ───────────────────

  UNIT 1  Hi!  (6-11)
     G: a - an; the verb 'to be'
     V: countries & nationalities;
        ordinal/cardinal numbers; jobs
     R: introducing people

  UNIT 2  A Friend in Need...  (12-17)
     G: the verb 'have (got)';
        the verb 'can' (ability, polite
        requests)
     V: people's appearances; abilities;
        colours
     R: Internet advertisements for
        pen-friends; Culture Point -
        people around the world

  UNIT 3  Home Sweet Home  (18-23)
     G: there is/there are;
        this/these - that/those;
        plurals (-s, -es);
        prepositions of place
     V: houses/homes; furniture &
        appliances
     R: advertisements for houses;
        Culture Point - houses around
        the world

  STORY 1: THE LOCH NESS MONSTER -
     EPISODE 1: THE ACCIDENT  (24-25)

  UNIT 4  Like Father, like Son  (26-31)
     G: possessive case; possessive
        adjectives/pronouns;
        whose/who's; present simple
     V: family relationships; free-time
        activities; days of the week
     R: letters to pen-friends

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 1 -
     UNITS 1, 2, 3, 4  (32-33)

─── MODULE 2 ───────────────────

  UNIT 5  An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
     (34-39)
     G: adverbs of frequency;
        prepositions of time (at, in, on)
     V: daily routines; telling the time;
        months; pros/cons of jobs
     R: article about a person's daily
        routine; Culture Point -
        opening hours in Holland

  UNIT 6  Birds of a Feather  (40-45)
     G: question words; irregular nouns
     V: describing animals; colours;
        sizes
     R: facts about animals

  STORY 1: THE LOCH NESS MONSTER -
     EPISODE 2: THE WRONG PHOTOGRAPH
     (46-47)

  UNIT 7  Come Rain or Shine  (48-53)
     G: present continuous;
        present continuous vs
        present simple
     V: weather conditions/climate;
        clothes
     R: postcards to friends while on
        holiday; Culture Point -
        weather in various countries

  UNIT 8  Enjoy your Meal  (54-59)
     G: plurals; countable/uncountable
        nouns; a/an/some;
        how much/how many;
        a few/a little; some/any
     V: types of food/drinks; meals;
        restaurants
     R: advertisement for a restaurant;
        Culture Point - eating habits in
        various countries

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 2 -
     UNITS 5, 6, 7, 8  (60-61)

─── MODULE 3 ───────────────────

  UNIT 9  Times Change...  (62-67)
     G: was/were, had, could;
        prepositions of place
     V: places/buildings in a town;
        giving directions; abilities
     R: article about a place then and
        now; Culture Point - life in
        ancient Rome

  STORY 2: THE EXPEDITION -
     EPISODE 1: THE WATERFALL  (68-69)

  UNIT 10  The Price of Fame  (70-75)
     G: past simple; asking questions
     V: famous people and their
        achievements; full dates
     R: Diana Spencer (biography);
        Backstreet Boys

  UNIT 11  All's Well that Ends Well
     (76-81)
     G: past simple; joining sentences;
        prepositions of movement;
        adjectives/adverbs
     V: feelings & reactions;
        danger & emergencies
     R: a story; Culture Point -
        a folk tale from Holland

  UNIT 12  See New Places, Meet New
     Faces  (82-87)
     G: comparisons; quite, too, very,
        much
     V: towns/cities; transport;
        holidays
     R: article about LA; Culture Point -
        Stratford-upon-Avon

  STORY 2: THE EXPEDITION -
     EPISODE 2: THE JIVARO INDIANS
     (88-89)

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 3 -
     UNITS 9, 10, 11, 12  (90-91)

─── MODULE 4 ───────────────────

  UNIT 13  Time will Tell  (92-97)
     G: be going to; will;
        present continuous (future
        meaning); it/there will be
     V: future plans/intentions;
        arrangements; future predictions
     R: letter to a friend about summer
        plans; horoscopes

  UNIT 14  Dos and Don'ts  (98-103)
     G: should/shouldn't (advice),
        must (obligation),
        mustn't (prohibition),
        can (giving permission),
        can't (refusing permission)
     V: the environment; health tips;
        house rules/school rules
     R: leaflet giving advice on how to
        protect the environment;
        Culture Point - tips for
        travellers

  UNIT 15  Take a Break  (104-109)
     G: present perfect;
        revision of all tenses
     V: holidays/sightseeing;
        describing a city
     R: letter to a friend; Culture
        Point - tipping in America

  STORY 3: STRANGE VISITORS  (110-113)

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 4 -
     UNITS 13, 14, 15  (114-115)

─── OXIRGI BO'LIMLAR ───────────

  IRREGULAR VERBS  (116)
  PHOTO FILE SECTION  (bet raqami yo'q)
  CULTURE CLIPS  (153-163)
  AMERICAN ENGLISH-BRITISH ENGLISH
     GUIDE  (164-166)


⚠⚠ MUNDARIJADA WORD LIST YO'Q!

  Pastki ro'yxatda to'rtta bo'lim
  sanalgan, LEKIN 119-124-betlardagi
  WORD LIST ro'yxatga KIRITILMAGAN.

  ⚠ Buni kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim —
  haqiqatan yo'q.

  ⚠ Ya'ni o'quvchi mundarijaga qarab
  Word List borligini bilmaydi.


⚠⚠ MODULLAR TARKIBI TASDIQLANDI:

     Module 1 = Units 1, 2, 3, 4
     Module 2 = Units 5, 6, 7, 8
     Module 3 = Units 9, 10, 11, 12
     Module 4 = Units 13, 14, 15  ← 3 ta

  ⚠ Bu orqa muqovadagi
  'four modules of FOUR UNITS EACH'
  da'vosining noto'g'ri ekanini yana bir
  bor tasdiqlaydi. Kitobda 15 unit bor,
  16 emas.


⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ — 153-BET:

  'CULTURE CLIPS (pp. 153-163)'

  ⚠ Demak Culture Clips muqovasi (bet
  raqami bosilmagan sahifa) aynan
  153-bet.

  ⚠ 'PHOTO FILE SECTION' yonida esa bet
  raqami YO'Q — chunki u varaqlar
  raqamlanmagan (qirqib olinadi).


⚠⚠ QIZIQ NARSA — UNIT NOMLARI IBORALAR!

  Deyarli har unit nomi — ingliz IBORASI
  yoki MAQOLI:

  'A Friend in Need...'
     to'liq maqol: 'A friend in need is
     a friend indeed.'
     = Do'st boshga kun tushganda bilinadi.

  'Home Sweet Home'
     = Uyginam, shirin uyginam.
     (Uydan yaxshi joy yo'q.)

  'Like Father, like Son'
     = Otasiga o'xshaydi.
     (Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.)

  'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'
     'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam
     'a night owl' = kechasi uxlamaydigan
        odam
     ⚠ 'The early bird catches the worm.'

  'Birds of a Feather'
     to'liq maqol: 'Birds of a feather
     flock together.'
     = Bir xil odamlar birga bo'ladi.
     ⚠ Unit HAYVONLAR haqida — so'z o'yini!

  'Come Rain or Shine'
     = Yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
     (= har qanday sharoitda)
     ⚠ Unit OB-HAVO haqida — yana so'z o'yini!

  'All's Well that Ends Well'
     = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi.
     ⚠ Shekspir pyesasining nomi ham.

  'Time will Tell'
     = Vaqt ko'rsatadi.
     ⚠ Unit KELASI ZAMON haqida!

  'Dos and Don'ts'
     = Qilish va qilmaslik kerak bo'lgan
       narsalar
     ⚠ Unit 'should/must/mustn't' haqida!

  'Take a Break'
     = Dam olmoq, tanaffus qilmoq
     ⚠ Unit TA'TIL haqida!

  ⚠ Ya'ni sarlavhalar unit MAVZUSI bilan
  so'z o'yini orqali bog'langan. Bu —
  kitobning chiroyli dizayn yechimi.


⚠ IMLO TASDIG'I:

  Bu yerda '14-UNIT: Dos and Don'ts'
  TO'G'RI yozilgan (oddiy apostrof bilan).

  ⚠ Workbook mundarijasida esa
  'Dos and Don´ts' — O'TKIR URG'U belgisi
  bilan XATO yozilgan edi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni xato faqat Workbook'da.


⚠ 'CULTURE POINT' NIMA:

  Ko'p unitlarda 'Culture Point' bor —
  bu O'QISh matnining ichidagi kichik
  madaniy izoh.

  ⚠ Bu 154-163-betlardagi katta 'CULTURE
  CLIPS' bo'limidan BOShQA narsa.

BU BET — KITOBNING KIRISh SO'ZI
(Introduction).

  Matn asosan O'QITUVChILARGA
  mo'ljallangan: kitob qanday tuzilgani
  va har bo'lim nima uchun kerakligi
  tushuntiriladi.

  ⚠ Lekin o'quvchi uchun ham foydali —
  kitobdan qanday foydalanishni
  ko'rsatadi.


⚠⚠ SKANERDA 4-BET YO'Q:

  Mundarija 2-3-betlarda tugadi, keyingi
  skaner esa 5-bet.

  ⚠ Bet raqamini kesib kattalashtirib
  tekshirdim — aniq '5'.

  ⚠ Kirish matni 5-betda TO'LIQ (chap
  ustun boshlanadi, o'ng ustun tugatadi).
  Demak 4-betda boshqa narsa bo'lgan,
  ehtimol bo'sh bet.


⚠⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM TOPILMA:

  Kirish matnida ANIQ yozilgan:

     'The course consists of FIFTEEN
      UNITS in four modules and a variety
      of supplementary material,
      including a workbook. In total,
      Enterprise 1 Beginner may be
      covered in 70-75 teaching hours.'

  ⚠ 'FIFTEEN UNITS' = 15 UNIT!

  ⚠⚠ Bu orqa muqovadagi
  'four modules of FOUR UNITS EACH'
  (= 16 unit) da'vosini KITOBNING O'ZI
  RAD ETADI.

  Endi 15 unit ekani UCh manbadan
  tasdiqlandi:
     1) bu kirish matni — 'fifteen units'
     2) 2-betdagi mundarija —
        'Module 4: Units 13, 14, 15'
     3) modul muqova sahifalari —
        'Module 4 (Units 13-15)'

  ⚠ Ya'ni XATO faqat ORQA MUQOVADA.


⚠ FOYDALI MA'LUMOT — DARS SOATI:

  'may be covered in 70-75 teaching
   hours'

  = kursni 70-75 dars soatida o'tish
    mumkin.

  ⚠ Haftada 3 soatdan o'qilsa — taxminan
  24-25 hafta, ya'ni bir o'quv yili.


UNIT TUZILIShI (kirish matnidan):

  1) LEAD-IN sections
     Mavzuga kirish. O'quvchining bilgani
     eslatiladi, yangi so'z va grammatika
     oldindan ko'rsatiladi. Tinglash bilan
     tugaydi.

  2) READING sections
     50-150 so'zli matnlar.
     ⚠ 'reading for gist' = umumiy
        mazmunni tushunish
     ⚠ 'reading for specific information'
        = aniq ma'lumotni topish

  3) LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT sections
     a) Vocabulary — lug'at
        ⚠ KOLLOKATSIYALAR o'rgatiladi:
        so'zlar ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA
        holda yodlanadi.
     b) Grammar — grammatika

  4) READING and LISTENING sections
     Haqiqiy, madaniyatlararo mavzular.

  5) PRONUNCIATION
     Tovushlarni tanish va to'g'ri aytish.
     ⚠ Barcha talaffuz mashqlari
     kassetalarda.

  6) COMMUNICATION sections
     Haqiqiy hayotga o'xshash muloqot:
     taklif qilish, ovqat buyurtma qilish
     va h.k.

  7) WRITING sections
     Yozish. Har vazifa oldindan
     tayyorlanadi va o'qish matni namuna
     bo'ladi.

  8) MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT sections
     Har to'rtinchi unitdan keyin
     takrorlash.

  9) UChTA SARGUZAShT HIKOYASI
     ⚠ 'in a COMIC STRIP format' =
     KOMIKS shaklida!
     Har biri ikki epizodda.

 10) CULTURE CLIPS


⚠⚠ 'COLLOCATIONS' — MUHIM TUShUNChA:

  Kirish matnida: 'A particular feature
  of the book is the teaching of
  COLLOCATIONS, helping students to
  remember vocabulary items as parts of
  SET EXPRESSIONS.'

  ⚠ 'a collocation' = birga keladigan
  so'zlar birikmasi.

  Masalan:
     'MAKE a decision' (do EMAS)
     'DO exercise' (make EMAS)
     'TAKE a break'
     'HAVE breakfast'

  ⚠ Kitob so'zlarni ALOHIDA emas,
  BIRIKMA holda o'rgatishni maqsad
  qilgan — biz ham shu yo'ldan borganmiz.


HAMROHLIK QILUVChI MATERIALLAR:

  a) Teacher's Book — barcha javoblar,

     ikki variantda)
  b) Class audio cassettes yoki CDs;
     Student's audio cassettes yoki CDs
  c) Enterprise Beginner Workbook
  d) Enterprise Beginner Test Booklet —
     to'qqizta test, Mid-term test va

  ⚠ Bu yerda ham GRAMMAR BOOK tilga

⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK:

sentencePatterns.formula: In Unit [raqam] you learn how to [vazifa].

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 8-unitda restoranda ovqat buyurtma qilishni o'rganasiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'learn HOW TO' + fe'l — ko'nikma
o'rganish qolipi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Project for Unit 12 is a description of your town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 12-unitning loyihasi — o'z shahringiz tasviri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Har unitda 'Project' bor — o'z
mamlakating haqida yozish vazifasi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Unit 10 practises the sounds /t/, /d/ and /id/.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 10-unit /t/, /d/ va /id/ tovushlarini mashq qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to practise' — BrE da FE'L 's' bilan
(166-betga qarang).

sentencePatterns.formula: The course consists of [nechta] units in [nechta] modules.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The course consists of fifteen units in four modules.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kurs to'rt moduldagi o'n beshta unitdan iborat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'consist OF' — 'of' shart.
⚠ Sonlar SO'Z bilan yozilgan ('fifteen'),
raqam bilan emas — rasmiy uslub.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Enterprise 1 Beginner may be covered in 70-75 teaching hours.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Enterprise 1 Beginner ni 70-75 dars soatida o'tish mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Majhul nisbat + 'may' (ehtimol).
⚠ 'to cover' = o'tmoq, o'rganib chiqmoq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pronunciation activities help students to recognise sounds.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Talaffuz mashqlari o'quvchilarga tovushlarni tanishga yordam beradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'help sb TO do' yoki 'help sb DO' —
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: ENTERPRISE — GRAMMAR 1 — Student's Book — Virginia Evans, Jenny Dooley
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ENTERPRISE — GRAMMATIKA 1 — O'quvchi kitobi — Virjiniya Evans, Jenni Duli
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Har darslik muqovasidagi standart tartib.

sentencePatterns.formula: The information is THE SAME, but the design is DIFFERENT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The information on the title page is the same as on the cover, but the design is different.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sarlavha betidagi ma'lumot muqovadagidek, lekin bezagi boshqacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the same AS' (bilan bir xil) va
'different FROM' (dan farq qiladi) —
predloglarga e'tibor bering.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First edition 1999. New edition 2000.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Birinchi nashri 1999. Yangi nashri 2000.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kitob 1999-yilda chiqqan, 2000-yilda qayta
ishlangan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Made in EU.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yevropa Ittifoqida ishlab chiqarilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbatning qisqargan shakli
('It IS made in ...').

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Unit 1  Subject Pronouns - The Verb 'to be' - Indefinite Article A/An ..... p. 4
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1-unit  Ega olmoshlari - 'to be' fe'li - Noaniq artikl A/An ..... 4-bet
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Mavzular CHIZIQCHA bilan ajratiladi.
Workbook mundarijasida esa har unitning
bitta MAQOL nomi bor edi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book teaches the Present Perfect in Unit 15.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitob Present Perfect ni 15-unitda o'rgatadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Mundarija — butun yillik dastur.
Eng qiyin mavzu (Present Perfect) OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: ENTERPRISE 1 Beginner — Virginia Evans, Jenny Dooley — Express Publishing
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ENTERPRISE 1, boshlovchilar uchun — Virjiniya Evans, Jenni Duli — Express Publishing
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Har kitob muqovasidagi standart tartib.

sentencePatterns.formula: This book is WRITTEN BY [muallif] and PUBLISHED BY [nashriyot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book is written by Virginia Evans and Jenny Dooley, and published by Express Publishing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitobni Virjiniya Evans va Jenni Duli yozgan, Express Publishing nashr qilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat: 'is written BY',
'is published BY' — ish bajaruvchi 'by'
bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Published by Express Publishing. © Virginia Evans - Jenny Dooley, 1997.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Express Publishing nashr qilgan. © Virjiniya Evans - Jenni Duli, 1997.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Har kitobda bo'ladigan standart qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: No part of this publication MAY BE + [V3] ... without the prior written permission of ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No part of this publication may be reproduced ... without the prior written permission of the Publishers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu nashrning hech bir qismi Nashriyotning oldindan yozma ruxsatisiz ko'paytirilishi mumkin emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat + 'may'.
'NO part ... may be ...' — inkor ma'no.

sentencePatterns.formula: The authors WISH TO THANK ... who HAVE kindly GIVEN permission ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The authors and publishers wish to thank the following who have kindly given permission.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mualliflar va nashriyot ruxsat berganlarga minnatdorchilik bildiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'wish to' — rasmiy ('want to' — oddiy).
'have given' — Present Perfect.

sentencePatterns.formula: Every effort HAS BEEN MADE to + [ASOSIY fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Every effort has been made to trace all the copyright holders.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Barcha huquq egalarini topishga harakat qilindi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL Present Perfect — rasmiy matnlarda
ko'p uchraydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Unit 1  Hi! ..... p. 4
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1-unit  Salom! ..... 4-bet
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Mundarijaning standart qatori.
Nuqtalar nom bilan bet raqamini bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Unit 1 p.4 → Unit 2 p.8 → Unit 3 p.12 ...
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har raqam oldingisidan 4 ga katta
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
15 unit × 4 bet = 60 bet
(4-betdan 63-betgacha).
Kitob juda tartibli tuzilgan.
